reviews.review: Oh huh I never reviewed this...lol. Yeah it's good. Great co-op game on top of a solid single player game. PvP isn't too bad either, though I wouldn't call it the focus of the game.  Definitely grab it if you like 3rd person action games, Gears of War, or Warhammer 40k.

Its never been more fun to kill Tyranids :D


Edit: Since I last reviewed this game, I've finished the campaign and played some PvE operations and siege mode. This game is SO INCREDIBLY FUN

The PvE, even with randoms, is still a lot of fun. I've heard that on higher difficulties, randoms will start being more people who are looking to get carried and will leave if they die, but I've played on like low to medium difficulties and I've only had good experiences. \

This game can be really cinematic at times and it makes you feel like a part of a unit. For example, in siege mode, the first time I played it it was with 2 randoms. 

I forgot which wave, but probably wave 10 or a wave after that, I could tell we were reaching our breaking point. All of us were low health, we were all in different parts of the map, stuck as we all got swarmed by Tyranids. I lost all of my armour as I was fighting against the swarm, and as I watched my health bar getting smaller and smaller, I could tell it was the breaking point. I ran towards the nearest requisiton terminal, tyranids right behind me. I reached it with a sliver of health, called in a Dreadnought, and then died as I watched it come in. 
I might've fallen, but I got to see it come in just in time to save my teammates. 

Plus, theres this sense of brotherhood in this game too. In PvE, I can't think of a single time when I got downed that my teammates didn't drop everything just to come and save me, or die trying. And same for when I saw my teammates fall. It makes you feel like you're a part of a team, working as a unified force to achieve your goal. 

So yeah, I highly recommend it. 

Rating: I give it 40 Hormagaunts out of 20 Servitor Skulls
